slots.headline: Why Matcha?
slots.subtitle: The green tea that's more than just a trend.

slots.title: Sustained Energy Daily
slots.body: No jitters, no crash. Matcha delivers calm alertness thanks to L-theanine and caffeine working in sync. It's your morning ritual, upgraded.

slots.title: Loaded With Antioxidants
slots.body: One cup packs more catechins than regular green tea. It fights free radicals and supports glowing skin from the inside out.

slots.title: Boosts Focus Naturally
slots.body: Swap the espresso for something smoother. Matcha sharpens concentration without the anxiety, keeping you in flow all afternoon.

slots.title: A Ritual Worth Savoring
slots.body: The whisk, the water, the moment. Preparing matcha slows you down and turns a simple drink into mindful self-care.

slots.title: Versatile In Every Recipe
slots.body: Lattes, smoothies, baked goods, you name it. Its earthy, creamy flavor elevates everyday treats without overwhelming them.

slots.title: Join The Green Wave
slots.body: This isn't a fad; it's a lifestyle. One daily bowl connects you to centuries of tradition and modern wellness.
